role: A no-lookahead half-month oil strategy with separate strategy-research intent, risk-department strategy review, investment-committee risk approval and capital authorization, company-wide risk enforcement, and capacity-constrained weekly execution.
invariants: strategy research creates intent but cannot approve its own risk or capital
the risk department proposes one strategy mandate from the appointed strategy and company-risk profiles
the investment decision committee separately approves risk policy and authorizes strategy capital
the strategy director's deployment preference applies only inside committee-authorized capital
strategy risk runs before company risk; each layer can preserve or shrink intent but never enlarge or reverse it
company risk evaluates aggregate company requirements and market hard limits remain final
all decisions use only visible market, published forecast, account state and appointed profiles
configured research capability scores never enter signal, position sizing, risk approval, fill or execution-cost formulas
execution ability never changes forecast signals or strategy intent
net adjustment and round trips share one published gross execution capacity
buy lots minus sell lots equals net position change and buy lots plus sell lots equals gross turnover
the strategy never changes public prices, market volume, market open interest, forecasts or macro rows
